facts.fact: Tchad Vision reports that Ordonnance n°001/PR/2026 of 22 January 2026 reforms the national computer security and electronic certification agency ANSICE, extending its missions, powers and operational capacity.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de sécurité informatique et de certification électronique

facts.fact: Tchad Vision reports the National Assembly approved on 16 February 2026, by 160 votes to 1 with no abstention, the bill ratifying Ordonnance n°001/PR/2026 of 22 January 2026 reforming ANSICE to modernise the legal framework on cybersecurity and fight cybercrime.
